# Getting help

Lumastra is built and maintained by one person, in spare time. It's an early release (v0.1).
Please read this before asking, so your question lands in the right place.

## Where to go

- **Install, configuration, deployment, clients:** read the docs at
  [lumastra.org](https://lumastra.org) first, especially
  [known limitations](https://lumastra.org/reference/known-limitations/).
  Something wrong or missing in the docs? Open an issue or a pull request in
  [Sapd/lumastra-docs](https://github.com/Sapd/lumastra-docs).
- **Questions and "how do I…":** ask in
  [Discussions](https://github.com/Sapd/lumastra/discussions), in the category that fits
  (install help, deployment & operations, playback & clients, plugins & API).
- **Chat and quick help:** the [Lumastra Discord](https://discord.gg/ZhaFYkuqq9). Ask in the `#help` forum,
  one post per question. Discord answers can't be found with a web search, so for questions
  others will have too, Discussions is the better place.
- **Bugs:** open an [issue](https://github.com/Sapd/lumastra/issues/new/choose) with the
  template. Include the version string, your setup, and the steps to reproduce. For
  playback problems, the playback template tells you which diagnostics to attach.
- **Problems with the iPhone, iPad or Apple TV app:** report them here as well, with the
  same templates. The apps are closed source, so pull requests aren't possible for them,
  but reports are very welcome. In the app, Settings → Send Diagnostics gives you a
  reference to include.
- **Feature ideas:** the [Features](https://github.com/Sapd/lumastra/discussions/categories/features)
  category in Discussions. Issues aren't for feature requests.
- **Security problems:** report them privately, never in public. See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

## What to expect

- No new features are planned before 1.0. Until then the focus is bug fixes and polish.
- Replies and fixes can take a while. Not every question gets an answer from me; other
  users are welcome to help each other.
- If the number of issues grows, some areas may become best-effort (fixed when time allows).

## Piracy

Lumastra is for media you own or are licensed to use. Anything that points to pirated
content, such as indexers, release names in filenames or logs, or unlicensed IPTV lists,
isn't discussed here. Such posts are closed without an answer. Redact filenames and paths
before posting logs. The full rules are in the
[Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md#content-rules).
